body: Please do not edit the issue template, the sections are important for review, did you use AI to translate this? It left Arabic text in the steps to reproduce, and added a lot of additional details and rewrote the template

> However, surface_override_materials can have size 0 at the time of the call. I don't see how that could happen, as that array is always resized to the amount of surfaces: The only possibility I could think of is that you're using a custom `Mesh` class that doesn't emit the `changed` signal correctly (and thus de-syncing the array size and actual surface count). And also, as ATS mentioned, please do not use AI to write the description. Information like this isn't helpful: > [Insert exact steps here] [Insert the Mesh/Scene used here] [Insert the operation that triggers the call to get_active_material() here] Error appears in mesh_instance_3d.cpp. (translated the Arabic using Google Translate)

it's stable.

It is a setting for controlling the resolution of graphics, for example,
image resolution, material resolution, and lighting resolution.
This would be a truly wonderful addition
Thank you all.
